+                  sample.id=list("G08F07R","G09D02R","G09D04R","G09D05R","G09D07R","G09D08R","G09D10R", "G09E01R","G10C07R","G10D06R","G10D07",

"Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  :
